{
  "architect_scope": "one-R71-structural-factor-only",
  "proposal_mode": "counter_hypothesis",
  "qualitative_hypothesis": {
    "observed_bottleneck": "The champion requires a source-filtered terminal authority to reconstruct a complete policy from non-policy analysis, causing semantic commitment and contract discharge to occur only after evidence compression.",
    "causal_change": "Relocate the single irreversible semantic-closure boundary to a fully informed penultimate call and pass its complete executable policy capsule across an identity-only terminal edge.",
    "expected_effect": "Evidence conflicts are resolved before source loss, policy commitments stabilize earlier, and final emission cannot introduce reinterpretive drift.",
    "falsifier": "all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score"
  },
  "structural_mutation": {
    "change_count": 1,
    "factor": "preterminal immutable semantic-closure boundary",
    "before": "Semantic closure occurs inside a terminal policy authority operating under a permanent generative-source cut.",
    "after": "Semantic closure occurs in a fully informed penultimate authority; the terminal call sees only the resulting complete policy capsule and has identity-preserving emission authority.",
    "why_structural": "The mutation relocates the lineage's irreversible state transition and consequently changes commitment timing, downstream revision authority, and terminal visibility."
  },
  "mode_certificate": {
    "rejected_assumptions": [
      "A terminal call must retain interpretive policy authority.",
      "Terminal source-class segregation is the appropriate control principle.",
      "An analysis-only handoff is sufficient for terminal policy reconstruction."
    ],
    "forbidden_inherited_mechanism": "terminal policy construction from analysis under a permanent source-class visibility cut",
    "independent_replacement_principle": "irreversible preterminal semantic closure followed by identity-preserving terminal emission",
    "changed_behavioral_dimensions": [
      "timing of irrevocable policy commitment",
      "terminal revision authority",
      "terminal external-evidence visibility"
    ],
    "counter_until_promotion": true
  },
  "candidate_structure": {
    "name": "Preterminal Immutable Closure",
    "organization": "three-call sequential nonbranching lineage with one preterminal immutable semantic-closure boundary",
    "information_flow": "The first call receives all common inputs and emits analysis only. The second call consumes that analysis, directly receives all common inputs, and binds one complete executable policy capsule. The final call consumes only that capsule, cannot reacquire external sources or revise its semantics, and emits the same sole policy.",
    "stages": [
      {
        "id": "immutable_closure_lineage",
        "mode": "sequential",
        "calls": [
          {
            "id": "surface_assumption_conflicts",
            "role": "counter-assumption analyst",
            "objective": "Identify and preserve incompatibilities among inherited assumptions, counter-generative evidence, normative obligations, and structural constraints while emitting analysis only.",
            "inputs": [
              "task",
              "anchor_policy",
              "anchor_contract",
              "task_constraints",
              "candidate_hypothesis",
              "loop_structure"
            ],
            "output_type": "analysis"
          },
          {
            "id": "bind_preterminal_closure",
            "role": "fully informed semantic-closure authority",
            "objective": "Consume surface_assumption_conflicts, reconcile its distinctions with every directly visible common input, and bind one complete executable policy capsule irreversibly for downstream emission.",
            "inputs": [
              "surface_assumption_conflicts",
              "task",
              "anchor_policy",
              "anchor_contract",
              "task_constraints",
              "candidate_hypothesis",
              "loop_structure"
            ],
            "output_type": "policy_capsule"
          },
          {
            "id": "emit_closed_policy",
            "role": "authority-free terminal projector",
            "objective": "Consume bind_preterminal_closure and emit its sole complete policy while preserving all bound semantics and reacquiring no external source.",
            "inputs": [
              "bind_preterminal_closure"
            ],
            "output_type": "policy"
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "final_call_id": "emit_closed_policy"
  },
  "compliance": {
    "one_structural_factor_only": true,
    "score_or_trace_content_used": false,
    "policy_code_emitted": false,
    "variants_sampling_or_best_of_n_emitted": false,
    "hardcoding_emitted": false
  }
}
